name: link_known_error
description: link_known_error: Search the known error database for an entry matching the affected service and link it to an incident ticket. Returns the known error ID and workaround if a match is found, or indicates no match exists.

ticket_number.description: The incident ticket number to link (e.g. INC0048271).

service_name.description: The affected service to search the known error database for.
